name: mmk-vnd-exchange
description: P2P Exchange: currency calculator through USDT at Binance P2P rates. MMK, VND, USD, SGD, THB, AED, AUD, MYR, EUR, GBP. React + TypeScript PWA, works offline.

paragraphs: A fast, mobile-friendly currency exchange calculator for Binance P2P traders. Enter the price of 1 USDT in each currency, and convert any currency to any other through USDT, then see how much the customer receives at each service-fee tier.

Supported currencies: MMK Myanmar Kyat · VND Vietnamese Dong · USD US Dollar · SGD Singapore Dollar · THB Thai Baht · AED UAE Dirham · AUD Australian Dollar · MYR Malaysian Ringgit · EUR Euro · GBP British Pound.
features: Shop system: staff accounts, shared rates, exchange history, daily/monthly reports, Excel export, backups (details)
10 currencies, any pair, with a swap button; on iPhone the currency picker is the native scroll wheel
Rate freshness: "updated 5 minutes ago" on every rate, stale and sample rates highlighted
Installable app with offline support (PWA): home-screen icon, full screen, no internet needed
English and Burmese (မြန်မာ) interface, picked from the browser's language on the first visit

whatItDoes.text: A fast, mobile-friendly currency exchange calculator for Binance P2P traders. Enter the price of 1 USDT in each currency, and convert any currency to any other through USDT, then see how much the customer receives at each service-fee tier.

requirements.text: Staff who sign in also get a shared rate sheet, an exchange history, reports and Excel exports, backed by Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth, free plan).
In Authentication → Sign In / Providers, turn off "Allow new users to sign up" (keep the Email provider enabled).
